description: User story under REQ-192 for the probe catalog (FBS-218, issue 349). An AC may carry an optional probe on the AC itself (rcf-schemas minor) or in rcf/verify-catalog.json keyed by acId; rcf verify run --mode deterministic resolves each probe to pass, fail or skipped with evidence and keeps ACs with no probe critique-only.
asA: a verifier hand running the Test stage from a dispatched worker
iWant: every URL-verifiable criterion in scope to resolve to pass, fail or skipped from a declared probe without a model
soThat: Test-stage verification runs where the agent CLI may not be spawned and only subjective visual criteria need a critique

acceptanceCriteria.description: [happy] Given an in-scope AC whose probe is { path: "/health", expectStatus: 200 } and a target that serves 200 at that path, when rcf verify run --url <target> --fbs <fbs-id> --mode deterministic runs, then the report records that AC with result "pass", evidence carrying the observed status and elapsed time, runStats.counts.verified incremented, and the command exits 0 when every in-scope AC passed.

[failure] Given an in-scope AC whose probe expects status 200 and a body containing "ready", when the target serves 200 with a body without "ready" (or a different status), then the report records the AC with result "fail" and evidence naming the failed expectation and the observed value, runStats.counts.failed is at least 1 and rcf verify run exits 4.

[edge] Given an in-scope AC with no probe on the AC and no entry in rcf/verify-catalog.json, when deterministic verify runs, then the AC is recorded with result "critiqueOnly", runStats.counts.critiqueOnly counts it, the verdict is not PASS and the command exits 4; an AC with a probe whose target path is unreachable (transport error) is recorded "skipped" with the error kind, never "pass".

[happy] Given rcf/verify-catalog.json { catalogVersion: 1, probes: { "<acId>": Probe } } and an AC that also carries its own probe, when deterministic verify runs, then the AC-level probe is used and the report evidence names its source as "ac"; with only the catalog entry the source is "catalog"; a catalog key naming no AC in the tree makes rcf define validate report it and exit 3.

[happy] Given a probe carrying parityEnv "staging" and a run with --parity-env staging, when deterministic verify runs, then that probe is resolved and recorded; with --parity-env production the same probe is recorded "skipped" with reason "parityEnv mismatch", so a run never claims a probe it was not scoped to.

[happy] Given the rcf-schemas minor that adds the optional probe object to acceptanceCriterion, when rcf define update <us-id> --ac <ac-id> --probe '{"path":"/","expectStatus":200}' runs, then the AC carries the probe and rcf define validate exits 0; a probe carrying a key the Probe recordShape does not define, or an expectStatus that is not an integer, is refused with exit 3 naming the key.

[must-not] rcf verify run --mode deterministic never records "pass" for an AC that has no probe and never spawns a child process (no agent CLI, no browser MCP): on a chain where no in-scope AC has a probe it exits 4 with runStats.counts.verified 0.

title: Per-AC probes resolve URL-verifiable criteria in deterministic verify
